title: 5 mistakes beginners make with AI tools

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Beginners fail by ignoring protocol standards—5 is the precise number of critical errors that break AI workflows.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Mistakes aren’t just numbers—they’re human errors like misaligned training data or poor API integration.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You can’t fix what you don’t count. Five distinct mistakes are documented in TensorFlow and PyTorch best practices.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Counting mistakes narrows focus—real issues are systemic, like over-reliance on defaults or lack of model explainability.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Mistakes are the starting point for learning, not a checklist to tick off.
